description: This file is a test script for Git status commands focusing on ignored files, untracked files, and submodules. It contains multiple test cases that verify the behavior of Git status under various options and scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the specified commands, and checks the results.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual vs expected output for test validation.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Commits changes in the specified directory or with specific options.
